name: Kyoto
tagline: Where ancient temples meet quiet gardens
description: Kyoto served as the imperial capital of Japan for over a thousand years and remains the country's cultural heart. Wander through bamboo groves, thousands of vermilion torii gates, and perfectly raked zen gardens.

name: Queenstown
tagline: The adventure capital of the world
description: Set on the shores of Lake Wakatipu and surrounded by the Southern Alps, Queenstown is the go-to destination for bungee jumping, jet boating, skiing, and some of the most dramatic scenery on earth.

name: Zanzibar
description: This Indian Ocean archipelago blends white sand beaches with the winding alleys of Stone Town, a UNESCO World Heritage site steeped in Swahili, Arab, and colonial history.

name: Reykjavik
description: Iceland's capital is the launch pad for glacier hikes, geothermal lagoons, and dramatic waterfalls, while the city itself offers a compact, walkable center full of design shops and cafes.

name: Marrakesh
tagline: A maze of souks, spices, and riads
description: Lose yourself in the medina's narrow alleys, haggle for lanterns and rugs in the souks, and unwind in a rooftop riad as the call to prayer echoes across the Atlas Mountains skyline.

name: Banff
tagline: Turquoise lakes ringed by snowy peaks
description: Banff National Park is home to Lake Louise's glacial waters, endless hiking trails, and wildlife ranging from elk to grizzly bears, making it a year-round haven for outdoor lovers.

name: Bali
tagline: Rice terraces, temples, and surf breaks
description: From the terraced rice paddies of Ubud to the surf towns of Canggu and Uluwatu, Bali mixes spiritual retreats, tropical beaches, and a thriving café scene into one island.

name: Lisbon
description: Lisbon's tram-rattled hills, riverside promenades, and late-night fado bars make it one of Europe's most walkable and affordable capitals, with day trips to Sintra's fairytale palaces close by.

name: Cape Town
tagline: Table Mountain meets the two oceans
description: Cape Town pairs a dramatic natural backdrop with world-class vineyards, penguin colonies, and one of the most scenic coastal drives on the planet along Chapman's Peak.

name: Chiang Mai
description: Northern Thailand's cultural capital is known for its old-city temples, ethical elephant sanctuaries, and the Yi Peng lantern festival that fills the night sky with floating light.
